title: Crafted Ores
description: Tired of using silk touch for your ores? Well now you can craft them!
body:
Tired of having to get Silk Touch to mine Ores? With this Datapack you can craft your ores. The Recipe for the Deepslate Varient of the Ore is the same as the normal ore. These are the Ores you can craft:

- Coal
- Copper
- Iron
- Gold
- Diamond
- Emerald
- Lapis
- Redstone
- Nether Gold
- Nether Quartz
- Ancient Debris
